content_tree.supporting_text: Zero-knowledge cryptographic verification for institutional throughput.

items.title: Deterministic finality
items.body: Every transfer settles in a single round with a verifiable proof attached to the receipt.

items.title: Audit by construction
items.body: Ledger state is reproducible from signed inputs, so compliance replays are a query, not a project.

items.title: Institutional limits
items.body: Per-counterparty exposure caps are enforced inside the proof, not in a sidecar service.

content_tree.supporting_text: We onboard a limited number of institutions each quarter.
